claim_boundary: Offline build/verification/activation evidence does not establish task binding or replay separation. RQ5 passes only when the version-routed online evidence contract also passes all five correctness conditions.

configuration.routing_model: latest is resolved at approval time; retained version-routed gateway/catalog instances serve already-approved roots

gates.requirement: Day0 plus exact 1%, 5%, and 10% update publications; Day3 also has inserts/deletes
each of four publications has at least three independent builds
all builds for one day have identical semantic digests and artifact sizes
every activation uses the receipt produced by strict verification of the same artifacts
build + strict verification + activation <= 300000 ms for every sample
switch, first-query, and replay latency are measured for all three transitions
old task ledger unchanged by switch

online.measurement_boundary: experiment_only_router_over_four_retained_catalog_bound_gateway_services; excludes offline build_verify_activate and production routing

rq: Can TaskGate safely refresh a daily reporting publication while preserving task binding, ledger isolation, and replay separation?
